title: HS30086: Economics Of Informal Sector
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: None Course ContentsConcepts and Definitions; Approaches to
Development of the Urban Informal Sector; Labour Absorption in Urban Sectors
and Dualism in Urban Economy: Theoretical and Policy issues-Lewis Theory,
Todaros Model, Fei and Ranis Model; Migration and Informal sector; Production
and Market Relations: Formal and Informal Sector Linkage- Forward and Backward;
The Informal sector and the Income Distribution- The Inverted U Curve; Informal
Sector Vs Growth, Employment and Environment; Informal Markets - A Study of the
Rural Sector- Land, Labour, Credit and Insurance; Response of Informal Sector
to Trade Liberalization; Informal sector and Development Policy Dilemma;
Country Studies.
